digest.component_or_area: contribution process documentation and Gerrit workflow
propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked as work-in-progress to prevent erroneous submission when both votes are +1.
The current contribution flow lacks documentation on using Gerrit's WIP mechanism as the enforceable hold for changes with known findings, leaving only advisory holds in ticket comments and logs.

An author must know both the push-time form (git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main%wip) and the REST API form (POST /a/changes/<n>/wip) to mark a change WIP and the corresponding unmark paths (%ready and /ready).

Three documentation surfaces must carry the WIP rule: CONTRIBUTING.md as authoritative text, the packaged code-review guide for on-ramp discovery via rebar explain review, and AGENTS.md for bot workflows.
